backend/main.mo: Defines access-controlled user profiles and an admin-settable Android APK URL using Map storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing guided meditation feature changes with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend files for documentation and build planning.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Module Gradle config for the Android app defining SDK versions, build types, dependencies, and Capacitor integration.
frontend/android/app/src/main/AndroidMan: Android manifest configuring app metadata, WebView activity, deep links for Internet Identity, permissions, and providers.
frontend/android/app/src/main/java/ai/ca: Capacitor BridgeActivity enabling WebView settings and cookies for Internet Identity compatibility.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: App string resources defining app name, main title, package name, and custom URL scheme.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/fi: File provider configuration allowing various internal and external paths for sharing files.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/ne: Network security settings restricting cleartext traffic and whitelisting Internet Computer domains.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Top-level Gradle build file setting repositories, Android plugin versions, and the clean task.
frontend/android/capacitor.build.gradle: Generated Capacitor build config specifying Java compatibility and plugin dependencies.
frontend/android/gradle.properties: Gradle project settings including JVM args, AndroidX flags, and Jetifier enablement.
frontend/android/settings.gradle: Gradle settings including the app module and Capacitor Android module from node_modules.
frontend/android/variables.gradle: Shared Gradle variables defining SDK versions and library dependency versions.
frontend/BUILD_ANDROID_APK.md: Guide describing prerequisites and steps to build the Android debug APK, plus in-app download instructions.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration specifying app ID, web directory, server settings, and Android behavior.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme CSS variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point containing the root React mount node and script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling authentication, profile setup, navigation state, and rendering pages within a themed layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button that triggers Internet Identity login or logout and reflects current auth status.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their profile via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportDat: Exports filtered mood and thought history to a downloadable text file based on a selected date range.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Application layout with header, navigation, user actions, and responsive sidebar for navigating between pages.
frontend/src/components/reminders/InAppR: Displays a timed self‑care reminder banner based on scheduled reminder times.
frontend/src/components/settings/Android: Card that fetches and displays an Android APK download link or fallback build instructions.
frontend/src/components/support/Breathin: Animated breathing visual that cycles between inhale and exhale states when active.
frontend/src/components/vent/DistressPro: Renders a dialog prompting users to access crisis resources, with continue and navigate actions.
frontend/src/content/guidedMeditation.ts: Defines ambient sound metadata and provides a guided meditation script string.
frontend/src/content/supportModules.ts: Exports support module metadata including id, title, duration, and audio paths.
frontend/src/docs/audio-swapping.md: Stub markdown file introducing guidance for swapping background audio.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profile, verification stub, and APK retrieval using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers, theme variables, dark mode values, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ComingSoonPage.tsx: Displays a styled placeholder page for unreleased features with navigation back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityForumPage.ts: Renders an anonymous community forum where users can create posts and browse existing ones. Includes form handling, validation, and post submission via query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CrisisResourcesPage.t: Displays emergency and crisis support information with hotline numbers and external resource links. Includes alerts and styled cards for quick-access help.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows the main dashboard with feature cards that navigate to different wellbeing tools. Pulls the user profile and supports navigation via provided callbacks.
frontend/src/pages/EnhancedBreathingPage: Implements a timed breathing exercise with audio playback, volume control, and error handling. Provides play, pause, and reset functionality with a countdown timer.
Provides a guided meditation experience with selectable ambient sounds, audio error handling, and a countdown timer. Manages audio lifecycle and play/pause/reset controls.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section, feature highlights, and login and APK download components.
frontend/src/pages/MoodTrackerPage.tsx: Mood tracking page allowing users to log mood and burnout levels and view recent history.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Displays the app’s privacy policy with scrollable sections and a back navigation button.
frontend/src/pages/RelaxationPage.tsx: Provides inspirational quotes and wellness articles with tabbed navigation and quote cycling.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings hub showing user info, APK download, reminders, data export options, and privacy navigation.
frontend/src/pages/SupportModulePlayerPa: Audio-guided support module player with timers, play/pause controls, and graceful fallback if modules fail to load.
frontend/src/pages/SupportModulesPage.ts: Displays selectable real-time support modules as cards and triggers callbacks for navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ThoughtDiaryPage.tsx: Provides a form to log thoughts, emotions, and reframes, and lists previous entries from query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/ToolsPage.tsx: Shows wellness tool cards with visuals and navigates to breathing or relaxation tools when selected.
frontend/src/pages/VentRoomPage.tsx: Lets users submit anonymous vent messages with error handling and displays recent vents.
frontend/src/pages/VerificationPage.tsx: Renders a medical verification form with role-based fields and submits credentials for backend validation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters for persistent state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, content scanning, extended color system, custom radii, shadows, keyframes, and animations with typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata capturing app goals, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions for a production-ready Android app build.
